class.name: SpatialInventoryTrade
class.brief_description: Manages offers and settlement for a two-participant inventory trade.
class.description: Register the participants and their grids before requesting a trade. Once accepted, both participants can edit their offers until they lock them for settlement.

members.member: Current trade phase. Compare this value with the [enum Phase] constants.
Actor ID that requested the trade. A value of [code]0[/code] means there is no initiator.
Actor ID that received the trade request. A value of [code]0[/code] means there is no receiver.
Current trade revision. Read it to check whether trade state changed since it was displayed.

Optional callback that receives an item ID and returns a Dictionary with [code]key[/code], [code]quantity[/code], and [code]max_quantity[/code]. An empty Dictionary identifies an item without a stack record. Defaults to an empty callable.
Callback that receives the source stack ID and supplies a new, unused item ID when an operation splits a stack. Defaults to an empty callable.

Callback that receives proposed stack edits and a placement commit callable. Stage the quantity changes, invoke the commit once, and roll back the stack edits if the placement commit fails. Return a Godot Error. Defaults to an empty callable.
Optional callback that receives the trade stage and both actor IDs. Return an empty String or StringName to allow the stage, or a reason to deny it. Defaults to an empty callable.

Optional callback that receives the trade stage, both actor IDs, item ID, placement, stack data, and quantity. Return an empty String or StringName to allow the item, or a reason to deny it. Defaults to an empty callable.
Optional wallet that supplies balances and commits currency transfers during settlement. Set it before participants make currency offers. Defaults to [code]null[/code].

constants.constant: There is no open trade request or active trade.
The initiator sent a request and the receiver can accept it.
The request was accepted. Participants can manage and lock their offers.
Version used when exporting a trade snapshot.
Largest supported nonnegative balance, expressed in whole currency units.
Exclusive upper bound for a revision restored from a trade snapshot.
Maximum number of distinct currency IDs in one participant's offer.
Maximum number of source allocations tracked for returning an offered stack.
